evidence: The Fear & Greed Index improved from 22 (Extreme Fear) on November 9 to 29 (Fear) on November 10, showing an uptick of 7 points following a prolonged stretch of extreme fear (7-day average of 23.7). limitations: Sentiment indicators like the Fear & Greed Index are composite proxies and can remain in fear regimes during sustained downtrends without immediate price recovery.
